captured_clamp.parameter: Maximum Clamping Voltage VC, 8 x 20 us waveform
captured_clamp.value_class: GUARANTEED MAXIMUM at the stated test current (datasheet table)
captured_clamp.surge_current_name: IPK (datasheet test current at which VC is specified)
captured_clamp.source: Littelfuse LA Series datasheet Rev VL 16/9/2024, page 2
captured_clamp.usability: This is a complete, source-conditioned clamp: 395 V at 50 A, 8/20 us. A clamp without its current/waveform would not be usable.

rating_basis.notes: Peak pulse current ITM = 4500 A (8/20 us) is the survival rating and is 90x the 50 A clamp-test current. The datasheet tabulates no clamp voltage above 50 A.

clamp_at_product_surge.reason_null: The datasheet guarantees VC only at IPK=50 A. Under the provisional contract the prospective 8/20 us current is 500 A (L-L); the MOV clamps higher there (p.7 Figure 10 shows the 14 mm family V-I rising with current), but no guaranteed value is tabulated and the actual MOV current depends on the unknown clamp itself. Figure 10 was rendered and an automated curve trace was attempted; it hopped between adjacent curves (V130/V140/V150/V175LA10A) and was rejected as an unreliable instrument. No digitised value is used.
clamp_at_product_surge.direction: clamp rises with current, so 395 V is a lower bound for any I > 50 A

surge_contract.assumed_waveform: 1.2/50 us voltage / 8/20 us current combination wave
surge_contract.provenance_of_assumption: AR-VERIFY attempt-001 sourced the 1 kV/2 kV level to docs/architecture/induction_curriculum.md:2112 (a checklist item) and a second IEC 60335-1 OVC II 1500 V reference. No committed requirements document names a surge level; docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.md's EMC section lists filter parts but no test level.
surge_contract.mov_position: MOV is across L-N; it clamps the differential (L-L) mode only. The L-PE common-mode surge is not clamped by it.
what_would_settle_it: a committed/released product requirement document naming the surge standard, level and current waveform, and stating whether an L-PE clamp is fitted
capture (or measurement) of the V150LA10A(P) V-I curve so the clamp at the actual MOV current can be read
surge_contract.explicit_statement: This is NOT an adopted requirement. Every surge-derived number below is conditional on it.

derived_mosfets.which_mosfets: active-bridge MOSFETs (TEA2209T synchronous bridge; AR-VERIFY candidate IPW60R017C7, contract baseline IPW65R045C7). Each off bridge device blocks the line terminal voltage, which the L-N MOV clamps.
derived_mosfets.required_rating_basis: the terminal voltage the off device must block (surge-clamped line); NOT the controller's 700 V limit, NOT the 400 V bus
derived_mosfets.statement: 600 V has 1.52x against the SOURCED guarantee point. Because the clamp rises with current and is untabulated above 50 A, the margin at the product surge is unknown and strictly smaller. This does not make the device wrong; it makes the margin unquantified.
derived_mosfets.not_equated: The controller's 440 V operating / 700 V transient limits are NOT device requirements, and a MOSFET rating does NOT protect the controller.

derived_controller.controller: NXP TEA2209T active bridge rectifier controller, Rev. 1.1 (2021-04-14)

own_limits.source: TEA2209T p.8 absolute maximum ratings; p.12 note 'Mains transients or surges must be limited to voltages below 700 V.'

derived_controller.statement: At the sourced clamp (395 V @ 50 A) the nodes sit at 0.898 of the operating limit and 0.564 of the transient limit. If the surge current drives the clamp above 440 V (untabulated), the nodes exceed their OPERATING limit during the surge while staying under the 700 V transient limit. The node voltage is set by the circuit clamp; a higher-rated MOSFET does not lower it, and the 700 V transient allowance does not require an 800/1000 V device.
derived_controller.line_to_pe_common_mode: INDETERMINATE - not clamped by the L-N MOV; depends on the Y-cap / PE / dc-return network, not captured

internal_fault_boundary.statement: A line-surge MOV across L-N does NOT resolve an internally powered fault. The boost-switch-short capacitor-discharge loop (179.24 J stored in 2240.47 uF) never reaches the MOV terminals; U12 (shunt) is also outside that loop. The internal discharge loop is AR-PROTECT's question, not this task's, and no MOV clamp figure is admissible as a bound on it.
internal_fault_boundary.source: AR-FAULT attempt-001 retained netlist + corrected coordinator receipt; AR-PROTECT attempt-001 dispatch
